review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.location: Ramat Gan, Tel Aviv District, Israel
review_candidates.description: Description As a Senior Backend Software Engineer on Elsight’s Compute team, you’ll design, build, and own the backend services that power reliable connectivity for unmanned and autonomous systems. This is a hands-on senior role at the intersection of backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and production operations. You’ll make architecture decisions, take services from design through deployment and ongoing operation, and help ensure our systems remain scalable, secure, observable, and resilient across cloud and on-prem environments. You’ll work closely with Product and R&D teams, while raising the engineering bar through strong technical standards, code reviews, and mentorship. Who are we? Elsight builds the technology that keeps autonomous systems connected and mission-ready—anywhere, across air, land, and maritime domains. Our Halo platform is already field-proven across more than 500,000 operational hours and trusted by 80+ customers worldwide, from defense forces to commercial operators. We took a bold idea and turned it into a proven public company (ASX: ELS) at the forefront of the autonomy revolution. With 10x year-over-year revenue growth and rapid global expansion, we're scaling fast—and we're just getting started. Join us to work on hard, meaningful problems alongside people who care about getting them right, and to help shape one of the defining technology shifts of the decade. It’s time to scale up both the product and the team, and we’re looking for people to win with! You will… Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data models that support Elsight’s products and customer deployments. Own services end to end — from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement. Build and evolve systems that run across cloud and on-prem environments, with a strong focus on reliability, security, performance, and high availability. Improve our infrastructure and delivery foundations, including containerization, orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and internal developer tooling. Strengthen observability by defining meaningful metrics, dashboards, alerts, and SLOs, and by driving root-cause analysis and long-term fixes. Troubleshoot complex distributed-system, integration, and production issues using structured, hands-on problem solving. Contribute to architecture decisions and engineering standards, review code, create reusable patterns, and mentor other engineers. Collaborate closely with Product, Firmware/Hardware, and R&D stakeholders, clearly communicating technical tradeoffs and turning product needs into robust solutions. Requirements: Apply if you have… 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in designing and building production-grade backend systems. Strong knowledge of backend architecture, distributed systems, API design, databases, data modeling, scalability, and performance. Proven end-to-end ownership of services in production, including deployment, observability, debugging, incident response, and root-cause analysis. Hands-on experience with cloud and infrastructure technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code. Experience supporting systems across cloud and on-prem environments; familiarity with high-availability or multi-cloud architectures is a strong advantage. Strong programming skills in a modern backend language. Experience with Go or Rust is highly valued; Python is also relevant, and C/C++ is an advantage. Experience building SaaS, platform, security, cyber, SRE, or other mission-critical systems where reliability and operational excellence matter. Strong system-level understanding, including Linux, networking, security best practices, IAM, and secrets management. A track record of making pragmatic architecture decisions, writing high-quality code, reviewing others’ work, and mentoring engineers. Clear communication, strong cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs to different audiences. An ownership-driven, curious, and quality-focused mindset, with the ability to work independently and solve ambiguous problems in a fast-moving R&D environment. If you’ve made it this far and are excited about the opportunity, don’t let a few unchecked boxes hold you back. If you believe you’re a strong fit for the role, we’d love to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Are you ready to build the data foundations behind modern analytics, applications and AI solutions? At Advian, we are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design and build modern data solutions for our customers especially in the energy and manufacturing sectors. In this role, you will work hands-on with cloud data platforms and operational data, building reliable data solutions for a range of use cases, from analytics and data-driven applications to AI and machine learning. ADVIAN Advian builds advanced data and technology solutions for the energy and manufacturing sectors. We combine deep industry expertise with data, analytics, AI and software development to solve complex operational challenges and turn data into better decisions. Our projects range from modern cloud data platforms and analytics solutions to industrial and IoT data. Our flat and self-directed culture gives you the autonomy to make an impact while working with highly skilled colleagues. THE ROLE As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design and implement data solutions together with our customers and other Advians. Depending on the project, you may work across the full data lifecycle – from data ingestion and modelling to pipelines, databases and production-ready cloud solutions. Your responsibilities include: Designing and implementing data solutions on AWS and/or Azure Designing and building data models and databases Working with IoT, streaming and other operational data sources Designing and implementing data pipelines Building reliable, scalable and maintainable data solutions Making technical and architectural decisions together with customers and other experts Depending on your background and interests, you may also work with API development and different modern data platforms and technologies. What We Are Looking For We would be a great match if you have: Strong hands-on data engineering experience with AWS and/or Azure – expertise in one is enough, while experience with both is a definite advantage Solid skills in Python and PostgreSQL Experience with ETL/ELT, data modelling and database design Experience working with IoT and/or streaming data The ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions and take ownership of your work Fluent English It is considered a plus if you have: Fluent finnish Experience in designing and implementing APIs Experience with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake Knowledge of Data Vault modelling WHY ADVIAN This is an opportunity to work on data solutions where engineering choices have a real impact. You won’t be limited to implementing predefined tasks – you will have the opportunity to influence architectures, technology choices and how solutions are built. You will work with real operational and industrial data and solve challenges where data engineering is a central part of the solution. Flexible working hours and location A low-hierarchy and self-directed culture A supportive team of highly skilled professionals Opportunities to grow your expertise in modern data technologies Challenging and meaningful customer projects Read more about Advian and our people on our website. PRACTICAL DETAILS Permanent and full-time position (part-time work also possible) Location: Espoo or remotely from anywhere in Finland ARE YOU INTERESTED? Share your goals in your application and send it through our career portal no later than 25.9. Apply quickly, as we review applications continuously and may fill the position before the deadline! If you have any questions, feel free to contact our People Lead Pinja Fernström (pinja.fernstrom@advian.fi ) Only goals and dreams as limits!

Postula y sé parte del próximo desafío.

review_candidates.title: Robotics AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: 포지션 소개 Superb AI의 Robotics AI Engineer는 사족로봇과 로봇팔을 결합한 실물 시스템을 산업 현장에서 안정적으로 동작시키는 풀스택 로봇 엔지니어입니다. 해당 포지션은 ML/3D 팀이 만든 perception·지도·환경 모델을 통합하여 실제 로봇이 움직이고 조작하고 안전하게 멈추는 Execution Layer를 책임집니다. Simulation 데모나 이론 연구가 아닌 Real-world deployment, 로봇 하드웨어 운용/디버깅, teleoperation 기반 데이터 수집 및 조작 성능 고도화를 책임집니다. 이 포지션의 매력 Founding Role로 사족로봇 및 로봇팔 기반 Physical AI robotics capability를 설계합니다. 회사 단계에 따라 manipulation 데모 개발(초기)에서 현장 deployment로 무게 중심이 자연스럽게 진화합니다. 3D / 영상관제 / 데이터 역량과 결합된 새로운 Physical AI Application을 만들 수 있습니다. FR3, Piper, G1, Go2 등 확보된 로봇 자산과 실험 공간을 제공합니다. 문제 정의부터 시스템 설계, 실험 방식, 도구 선택, 협업 방식까지 큰 자율성을 갖고 일합니다. 주요 업무 Robot System Integration (사족로봇 + 로봇팔) 사족로봇과 6–7 DoF 로봇팔/그리퍼를 통합한 운영·제어 시스템(ROS2 기반)을 구축합니다. 하드웨어 구성, 캘리브레이션, 센서/카메라 셋업 및 기본 제어 인터페이스를 구현합니다. Manipulation task를 정의하고 구현합니다. (1) 문 손잡이/문 개폐, (2) 버튼/레버 조작, (3) 바닥 물체 집어 옮기기(Pick & Place) Motion Planning을 구현하고 최적화합니다. (IK, collision avoidance, trajectory generation, 필요 시 RL 기반 정책 학습/적용) Real-world Data & Teleoperation 물체 상호작용 데이터 수집 시스템을 구축하고 운영합니다. (Teleoperation 등) 데이터 품질/커버리지 평가 파이프라인을 구축하고 운영합니다. (성공·실패 시나리오 포함) 수집 데이터 기반 조작/정렬 혹은 정책 fine-tuning 파이프라인을 구축합니다. (PyTorch 등) Deployment, Operations & Safety 현장 이슈 대응 및 재발 방지 업무를 수행합니다. (센서 오작동, 액추에이터 과부하, 캘리브레이션 드리프트 등) 속도/힘 제한, 임계치 초과 시 강제 정지(E-stop 포함) 등 안전 제어 로직을 구현합니다. PoC 및 실환경 기준의 안전 가드레일을 설계합니다. 장시간 운용 시나리오(예: 8시간 이상) 안정성을 확보하고 리스크를 관리합니다. Cross-functional Collaboration Machine Learning, 3D Vision, Video Analytics 팀과 함께 협업하여 robot navigation/perception 모듈을 통합·운영 관점에서 연결하고, 실물 로봇 시스템을 구현합니다. ※ 본 포지션은 Digital Twin, 3D reconstruction, SLAM 등을 "새로 개발"하는 역할이 아닌, 타 팀에서 개발하는 기술을 활용해 실물 로봇이 현장에서 안정적으로 동작하도록 만드는 Execution 중심 역할입니다. 자격 요건 Computer Science, Robotics 등 유관 분야 학위 또는 그에 상응하는 경험이 있는 분 Robotics 관련 5년 이상 실무 경험이 있는 분 Python 및 C++ 기반 ROS2 로봇 소프트웨어 구현 경험이 있는 분 실물 로봇 하드웨어/센서 디버깅 경험이 있는 분 (현장 문제 진단 및 해결) 6–7 DoF 로봇팔 및 그리퍼 통합 제어 경험이 있는 분 (Motion Planning, IK, trajectory generation, collision avoidance 포함) 산업 현장(물류/제조/플랜트 등)에서의 로봇 운용/실증(PoC) 경험이 있는 분 우대 사항 Teleoperation 기반 데이터 수집 → 학습/평가 → 개선 루프를 운영해본 경험이 있는 분 RL 기반 control/policy 학습 및 실물 로봇 적용 경험이 있는 분 온프레미스/폐쇄망 환경에서의 제품 배포/운영 경험이 있는 분 로봇 안전 설계 경험이 있는 분 (가드레일, fail-safe, 운영 SOP 등) PyTorch 등 딥러닝 프레임워크 활용 경험이 있는 분 채용 절차 서류 전형 → 직무 인터뷰 → 조직문화 인터뷰 → 레퍼런스 체크 → 처우 협의 → 최종 합격 ※ 직무 인터뷰 시, 현장 과제 및 직무 관련 Project 발표가 진행됩니다. 지원 전 안내 Full-time 포지션의 경우 수습기간 3개월 후 정규 채용 여부가 결정됩니다. (수습 기간 급여 100% 지급) 제출 서류가 사실과 다른 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다. 제출 서류는 관계 법령에 따라 파기 및 반환합니다. 회사 소개 Superb AI는 Vision AI로 세상의 '눈'을 바꾸고 있습니다. 제조 공장과 물류센터, 공항, 호텔, 도시 인프라 등 사람의 시선이 닿기 어려운 곳에서도, Vision AI는 상황을 인식하고 판단을 지원해 산업의 효율을 높이며 세상을 더 스마트하게 변화시킵니다. Superb AI는 환경에 최적화된 Vision AI를 구현하기 위해, 기업이 직접 필요한 AI를 개발할 수 있는 Superb Platform을 제공하며, 복잡한 산업 현장에는 Superb AI 기술로 완성된 맞춤형 솔루션을 구축합니다. 이미 삼성, 현대, 한화, 두산 등 국내 주요 기업은 Superb AI의 기술로 산업의 혁신을 이루고 있으며, Toyota, Pepsi 등 글로벌 기업과 NVIDIA, AWS와 같은 파트너와 함께 Vision AI의 가능성을 확장해 나가고 있습니다. Vision AI가 바꿀 다음 세상의 기준, Superb AI와 함께 변화를 이끌 당신을 기다립니다. 🚀

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer - TypeScript / React / Node.js
review_candidates.description: Company Go10 Limited is a rapidly growing UK-based value-added distributor of consumer products, known for its focus, speed and agile operations. Technology is central to how we operate, with our internally developed Gateway platform supporting commercial, operational, ecommerce, supply chain and data workflows across the business. Go10 is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build and scale Gateway, our internally developed business platform. Gateway is a growing suite of applications used across the business, covering commerce, data, workflow and automation. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will own features end to end, from database schema and backend services through to the finished React interface. We are looking for someone comfortable working on complex applications, making sound technical decisions and delivering production-quality software. This role is focused on the Gateway application estate and its supporting services. It is not an AI, machine learning or data science position. What you'll do Build applications using TypeScript, React and Next.js. Develop backend services, APIs and business logic using TypeScript and Node.js. Design and maintain PostgreSQL/Supabase schemas, queries and migrations. Build complex application interfaces including dashboards, tables, forms, workflows and data visualisations. Turn designs into responsive, accessible production interfaces. Build reusable UI components and contribute to the Gateway design system. Implement authentication, permissions, RBAC, oAuth, OIDC, WIF and secure multi-tenant functionality. Build integrations with external APIs, webhooks and data services. Develop background jobs, queues and asynchronous workflows. Build features that behave correctly under retries, concurrency and partial failure, following established platform patterns. Improve testing, performance, observability and platform reliability. Review code and work within the established engineering standards and architecture. Core stack TypeScript React / Next.js Node.js PostgreSQL / Supabase Drizzle ORM Clerk and Supabase Auth Tailwind CSS shadcn / Radix Vercel Google Cloud REST APIs / webhooks GitHub / CI/CD What we're looking for Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong TypeScript experience across frontend and backend. Strong React and modern frontend development skills. Strong Node.js and API development experience. Strong PostgreSQL and relational data-modelling knowledge. Experience building complex, data-heavy web applications. Experience taking functionality from database through backend, API and UI to production. Experience with authentication, permissions and application security. Experience integrating third-party APIs and services. Understanding of asynchronous processing, transactions, concurrency and data integrity. Experience with testing, Git, CI/CD and production deployments. Strong written English and the ability to work directly with a UK-based team. Experience with Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant applications, ecommerce or workflow systems is a must. The person we're looking for You should be comfortable being given a business problem rather than a fully specified development ticket. You will need to understand the requirement, work with product and design, determine the appropriate technical approach and then build the complete experience. You should think beyond whether the code works, to consider security, permissions, data integrity, performance, failure states, usability and maintainability. review_candidates.title: Principal Software Engineer - Roblox Database
review_candidates.description: Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. Roblox’s database team develops the next-generation, multi-tenant database platform that elastically scales and underpins every online data workload at Roblox. As a principal engineer on the database team, you will shape the architecture, build and launch critical database capabilities that keep our services fast, reliable and efficient at global scale. You will report to the Technical Director for Storage. You Will Design and implement new engine features—indexing, storage formats, WAL and replication protocols, sharding, and query-planner enhancements—that push latency, throughput, and availability boundaries. Evolve the control plane to deliver elastic scaling, autonomous healing, and zero-downtime schema or tenant moves across global regions. Profile and optimize critical code paths using kernel-level tracing and advanced performance tooling; drive systematic tail-latency reductions. Establish engineering best practices by leading design reviews, performance benchmarks, failure drills, and post-incident retrospectives. Automate everything: develop frameworks for testing, CI/CD, rollout safety, observability, and autoscaling so that the platform operates hands-off at scale. Mentor and unblock engineers, fostering deep database craftsmanship and disseminating knowledge across Storage, Platform, and product teams. Engage with the open-source community—upstreaming patches, presenting learnings, and influencing the future of Postgres, RocksDB and related ecosystems. You Have 12+ years of experience in software engineering or a relevant field Deep experience with building and operating large-scale distributed databases or storage engines (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL/InnoDB, RocksDB, Spanner, Aurora, AlloyDB). Deep expertise in database internals—B-trees, MVCC, WAL, query optimization, buffer management—and strong skills in C/C++, GO or Rust. Hands-on experience with consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos) and multi-region replication models that deliver strong consistency and high availability. Proven success shipping high-QPS, low-latency services on container orchestration stacks (Kubernetes or Nomad) with comprehensive observability. Ability to turn ambiguous product requirements into a clear technical roadmap and influence cross-functional stakeholders. Passion for automation, rigorous testing, and data-driven decision-making that raises the reliability and efficiency bar. Bonus: upstream contributions to PostgreSQL, RocksDB or other OSS databases; familiarity with disaggregated storage, HTAP workloads, or custom query languages. For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page . Annual Salary Range $345,040—$399,420 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process. For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.
